{"metadata":{"description":"Build your workflow on an infinite canvas — text, design, app, image and video cards wired together on DeepSeek Harness.","id":"gh:1374026938","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-canvas-flow","slug":"ljcoder2015/dsh-canvas-flow","topics":["dsh-canvas-flow","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Build your workflow on an infinite canvas — text, design, app, image and video cards wired together "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"on DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-canvas-flow"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **Build your workflow on an infinite canvas.**
> Drag cards into a flow, connect them to pass data"},{"id":"p4s2","text":", and watch every step happen."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**dsh-canvas-flow** is an **infinite canvas plugin** running on DeepSeek Harness: a whole project li"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ves on one canvas — text cards write specs, design cards produce design drafts, app cards build runn"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"able web applications, and you can refine any element right in the preview."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Cards reference each other through connected edges: upstream artifacts feed directly into downstream"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" cards, and a few cards working together can carry large, complex tasks."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- Generate requirement documents with text cards, website designs or presentations with design cards"},{"id":"p8s2","text":", web applications with app cards, and images / videos with media cards."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **The project folder is organized by card type**: artifacts no longer sit flat in the canvas root "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"— text goes to `docs/`, apps to `apps/`, designs to `designs/`, images to `images/`, videos to `vide"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"os/`, audio to `audio/` (plus `data/`, `files/`, `folders/`).
Older canvases are **tidied automatica"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"lly the first time you open them**: only items sitting flat in the root are moved, one item per entr"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"y, with a numeric suffix on name clashes; anything that cannot be moved stays where it is. The root "},{"id":"p9s6","text":"`index.html` and subdirectories you have already organized are left untouched."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- Every card type supports export.
- Text cards: export as Markdown, plain text, Word, or PDF docume"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ery card type supports export.
- Text cards: export as Markdown, plain text, Word, or PDF documents."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- Design cards: export as Figma files, images, PDF, or PowerPoint."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- App cards: export the web application as a zip archive — double-click `index.html` to run it."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Installing the plugin"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Install the plugin from the DeepSeek Harness client.
Search for `dsh-canvas-flow` in the plugin mark"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"etplace and click install."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Roadmap"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Shipped"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Capability | Status |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| **Text** | The agent writes Markdown documents; export as Markdown, plain text, Word, or PDF |
| *"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"*Design** | The agent produces design drafts and makes precise second-pass edits to specific layers."},{"id":"p18s3","text":" Export as Figma files, images, PDF, or PPT |
| **App** | The agent writes web application code that"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" runs directly in the DeepSeek Harness client. Pick any element and the agent precisely edits that e"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"lement's code |
| **Image** | The agent generates images (Jimeng / Seedream) onto the card's artifac"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"t, with image-to-image via reference edges; keep talking in the session to keep iterating. Export th"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"e original image, or import one from your machine as the artifact |
| **Video** | The agent generate"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"s short videos (Jimeng / Seedance) with aspect ratio, duration, and resolution controls; a per-minut"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"e async task you wait on. Export the original clip, or import one from your machine |
| **Audio** | "},{"id":"p18s10","text":"The agent generates audio (Doubao `doubao-seed-audio-1-0`): dialogue, sound effects, music, and ambi"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"ence all go into one prompt; synchronous, up to 120 seconds per call. Export the original file |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Media generation uses **the host's own model configuration**: add a provider route in DeepSeek Harne"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ss's model settings that can serve Seedream / Seedance / Seed-Audio (fill in `baseURL` and `apiKeyEn"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"v`) — no plugin-side configuration needed.
When no usable route is found, the card tells you exactly"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" what it searched by and where to add one."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"One thing to know about audio: `doubao-seed-audio-1-0` is listed in Ark's model marketplace, but **t"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"he API lives in Doubao Speech** — its endpoint and key are not the same set as Ark's (auth is `X-Api"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"-Key`, not Bearer). A dedicated route is recommended:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"A single Ark route can also work (the plugin re-routes audio requests to the speech host), provided "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"that key is valid on both sides; if it is not, the 401 message tells you exactly which route to add."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**The card face is the artifact itself**: an image card is the image; video and audio cards carry th"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"eir native players — play them here, drag the progress bar. Every card on the canvas shares one size"},{"id":"p23s3","text":", **400×252**, and the media card face is **exactly 16:9**: the face is the picture. In a 200-wide c"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ard a 16:9 image is a narrow strip; and if the height were doubled (280), a 16:9 image would leave a"},{"id":"p23s5","text":" band of background above and below — so the height is derived from the panel's 16:9 (398×224 + 26 c"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"ard header + 2 border). Audio cards share the same size (one rhythm across the canvas since v1.79). "},{"id":"p23s7","text":"The card face and the double-click full-screen preview **read the same artifact and say the same thi"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"ngs** (file not yet generated / file too large)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**"Which model powers this conversation" and "which model generated this card" are two different thi"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ngs that one dropdown asks**: on text / design / app cards it selects the model for the session's ne"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"xt request (so only conversational models are listed — picking Seedream / Seedance there would only "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"fail the next turn); on image / video / audio cards it selects **which model generates this card**, "},{"id":"p24s5","text":"listing only that family (Seedream on image cards, Seedance on video cards), stored on the card itse"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"lf and **never touching the session**. Unset, it shows "auto", meaning pick by model family from the"},{"id":"p24s7","text":" DSH model configuration above. When set, it is really used — if the configuration no longer has it,"},{"id":"p24s8","text":" the card reports an error honestly (it never silently switches to another model); the choice travel"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"s with the work, and opening the same folder on another machine keeps it."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**One reference image is all image-to-image / image-to-video needs**: connect an edge from an image "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"card to another image or video card, and on generation that edge becomes the reference (the `image` "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"input for image-to-image, the first frame for video) — no need to publish the image as a URL first. "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"For video you can also choose whether it is the first frame (default), the last frame, or a referenc"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"o you can also choose whether it is the first frame (default), the last frame, or a reference image."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Next up"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Capability | Plan |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| **Media editing desk** | Inpainting / outpainting / matting for images, first & last frame plus ca"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"mera control for videos — as parameter panels on the node, not just conversation requests |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"MIT © 2026 ljcoder2015"}],"truncated":false}
